9. **Envoy authority and passage.** Mandates with engine-checkable limits, the authority to seal within them, credentials shown or hidden, and passage, basing and trade rights on sealed tablets ("Envoy authority and resident envoys" in the Ideas tab; questions 2, 3 and 14 of the old round report).
